# Events, values and commands

Retained events and owned handlers, application-owned `Value` state, command bindings and semantic feedback records.

(api-gui-forms-commandbinding)=
## CommandBinding

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/commands/command_binding/command_binding.hpp>
class CommandBinding final
```

CommandBinding owns deterministic subscriptions between one shared command and one ButtonBase while honoring independent synchronization options.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `CommandBinding(std::shared_ptr<Command> command, std::shared_ptr<ButtonBase> button, CommandBindingOptions options = {})` | Validates both shared owners, applies initial state, routes clicks to execute, and observes future state; copying is prohibited and moves transfer subscriptions. |
| `~CommandBinding() = default` | Disconnects through owned subscription-token destruction. |
| `CommandBinding(CommandBinding&&) noexcept = default` | Validates both shared owners, applies initial state, routes clicks to execute, and observes future state; copying is prohibited and moves transfer subscriptions. |
| `CommandBinding& operator=(CommandBinding&&) noexcept = default` | Move assignment transfers authority while copy assignment is prohibited. |
| `const std::shared_ptr<Command>& command() const noexcept` | Returns the retained command owner. |
| `const std::shared_ptr<ButtonBase>& button() const noexcept` | Returns the retained presentation owner. |

(api-gui-forms-delegate)=
## Delegate

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/event/delegate/delegate.hpp>
template <typename... Arguments> class Delegate final
```

A Delegate binds invocation only. It neither owns nor extends the lifetime of its target; Event subscription and Component revocation remain separate. Binding stores one object/context pointer and one compile-time-selected thunk.

(api-gui-forms-event)=
## Event

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/event/event/event.hpp>
template <typename... Arguments> class Event final
```

Event owns registration-ordered revocable callback slots, emits a stable snapshot, skips slots revoked before their turn, and compacts disconnected ownership after publication.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Event()` |  |
| `~Event()` |  |
| `SubscriptionToken subscribe(Callback callback)` | Deprecated. Connects a callback and returns a caller-held `SubscriptionToken`. Observe events with `on(event, owner, &Owner::method)` instead; these overloads remain for existing code that must cancel one connection independently. |
| `SubscriptionToken subscribe(const DelegateCallback callback)` | Deprecated. Connects a callback and returns a caller-held `SubscriptionToken`. Observe events with `on(event, owner, &Owner::method)` instead; these overloads remain for existing code that must cancel one connection independently. |
| `SubscriptionToken subscribe(Component& owner, Callback callback)` | Deprecated. Connects a callback and returns a caller-held `SubscriptionToken`. Observe events with `on(event, owner, &Owner::method)` instead; these overloads remain for existing code that must cancel one connection independently. |
| `SubscriptionToken subscribe(Component& owner, const DelegateCallback callback)` | Deprecated. Connects a callback and returns a caller-held `SubscriptionToken`. Observe events with `on(event, owner, &Owner::method)` instead; these overloads remain for existing code that must cancel one connection independently. |
| `void emit(Arguments... arguments)` | Calls every connected callback in registration order with the given arguments, skipping callbacks revoked before their turn. |
| `void disconnect_all() noexcept` | Revokes every connection to this event. |
| `EventStatistics statistics() const noexcept` | Returns the connected, disconnected and emitted callback counters. |

**Data members and type aliases**

```cpp
using Callback = std::function<void(Arguments...)>;
using DelegateCallback = Delegate<Arguments...>;
```

(api-gui-forms-event-memberslot)=
## Event::MemberSlot

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/event/event/event.hpp>
template <typename Owner, typename Method, typename... Bound> struct MemberSlot final : Slot
```

The event retains this named member-binding state in the same allocation as its slot. emit() holds the slot across revocation, so invoking the member neither copies an owning callable nor allocates. The owner is borrowed: registration never extends its lifetime or forms a cycle.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `MemberSlot(const std::shared_ptr<State>& event_state, Owner& owner, const Method method, Bound... bound)` |  |
| `method_(method), bound_(bound...)` |  |
| `template <std::size_t... BoundIndices, std::size_t... ArgumentIndices> void invoke_member(ArgumentTuple& arguments, std::index_sequence<BoundIndices...>, std::index_sequence<ArgumentIndices...>)` |  |
| `void invoke(Arguments&... arguments) override` |  |

**Data members and type aliases**

```cpp
using BoundTuple = std::tuple<Bound...>;
using ArgumentTuple = std::tuple<Arguments&...>;
// Value events do not grant mutation of the dispatch argument shared by later listeners. Explicit reference events retain that authority.
using ContractTuple = std::tuple<std::conditional_t< std::is_reference_v<Arguments>, Arguments, const Arguments&>...>;
Owner& owner_;
Method method_;
const BoundTuple bound_;
```

(api-gui-forms-subscriptiontoken)=
## SubscriptionToken

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/event/subscription_token/subscription_token.hpp>
class SubscriptionToken final
```

SubscriptionToken is the move-only RAII revocation handle for a retained Event slot; destruction and explicit disconnect are idempotent. It belongs to the deprecated subscribe(...) seam; new code observes events with on(event, owner, &Owner::method), which keeps its connection on the owner Component instead of a caller-held token.

(api-gui-forms-value)=
## Value

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/value/value.hpp>
template <typename T> class Value final : public Component
```

Application-owned scalar state. Notifications are synchronous on the UI execution thread. Equal writes do nothing; a different recursive write is rejected rather than creating an unbounded observer feedback loop.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit Value(const T initial = T{})` |  |
| `~Value() override` |  |
| `T get() const noexcept` |  |
| `Event<T>& changed() noexcept` |  |
| `Event<T>& validating() noexcept` |  |
| `void validate_candidate(const T value) const` | Controls validate before committing local state, so a constraint from a second bound control cannot leave the source changed after rejection. |
| `void set(const T value)` |  |
